sentences.text:
?Court No. - 85
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 9430 of 2022

Applicant :- Pawan Rana
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Vinay Kumar Pandey,Rajendra Kumar Pandey,Smt. Kirti Pandey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Jyotsna Sharma,J.
1.
Heard Sri Rajendra Kr. Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 400 of 2021, u/s 419, 420, 467, 468, 469, 470, 471 I.P.C., P.S.
Banda, District Shahjahanpur.

3. As per prosecution case, an F.I.R. has been lodged on the instructions of the District Magistrate,
Shahjahanpur that seven persons obtained job in the Army on the basis of fabricated papers.
4. It is contended on behalf of the applicant that his all the academic certificates/mark-sheets are genuine and that he never produced any false or fabricated paper for obtaining a job.

It is pointed out that the other co-accused persons, namely, Nishant Kumar and Deepak Shishodia have been granted anticipatory bail by the coordinate Bench of this Court vide orders dated 7.7.2022 passed in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application No. 4599 of 2022 and dated 19.5.2022 in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application No. 3601 of 2022, respectively.

sentences.text: Co-accused Mandeep Singh has also been granted interim protection by the coordinate bench of this Court on 3.6.2022 in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application No. 4656 of 2022.

sentences.text: It is argued that the F.I.R. does not disclose the paper which was purportedly found forged or fabricated.
It is further argued that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and that no possibility to flee from justice is there.

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail, but he could not point out any of the papers which were allegedly found fake or fabricated.
It is said that at the most may be the character certificate was found not genuine as is indicated in the F.I.R.
The matter is still under investigation and more evidence is required.

6. In case of Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra, (2011) 1 SCC 694, it has been held by Hon'ble Supreme Court that while deciding anticipatory bail, Court must consider nature and gravity of accusation, antecedent of accused, possibility of accused to flee from justice and that Court must evaluate entire available material against the accused carefully and that the exact role of the accused has also to be taken into consideration.

entities.text: Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra, (2011) 1 SCC 694
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 7. In the instant case, I considered submissions of the learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusation, role of applicant and all attending facts and circumstances.
In my view, a case for anticipatory bail is made out.
Hence, the present anticipatory bail application is allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court below shall have the liberty to cancel the bail granted to the applicant.

10. It is made clear that observations made in granting anticipatory bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion at any stage of the case based on material before him.
